"Next time you lie to protect me, you’re sleeping on the couch for a month," she said. Her voice was softer but still firm. Her hand moved to her stomach without thinking. 
Alpha Sebastian’s eyes followed her hand. His expression got gentler. He leaned closer, his lips near her ear. "I’m sorry. I was trying to protect you both." 
Before Cecilia could answer, the lights dimmed. 
Music started playing from hidden speakers. A man appeared on a stage at the far end of the ballroom. 
"Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to tonight’s show. The midnight party starts in a few hours. Until then, enjoy the performances." 
First came a string quartet. Then an opera singer whose voice filled the huge room easily. 
Cecilia looked at the program. 
Two full pages of shows before the main event at midnight. Like a really expensive theater night. 
An acrobatic group took the stage next. 
They did amazing stunts that seemed almost impossible.
###Chapter 428 The Witch’s Shadow

The witch was controlling them.

Bones cracked as his human form stretched larger. His expensive suit ripped apart as thick black fur covered his skin. 
His face changed into a wolf’s head with sharp white fangs. His eyes turned bright gold and seemed to glow with power. 
In seconds, a huge black wolf stood where Alpha Sebastian had been. 
The wolf was massive, bigger than any normal wolf. His fur was dark as night and his muscles were strong and powerful. 
Soren let out a deep, threatening growl. The sound was so loud it made the whole hall shake. 
The witch’s dark energy rose to meet him, black magic tentacles clashing with pure Alpha strength. 
All hell broke loose.

Tang and Beta Sawyer moved quickly to shield Cecilia, Harper, and Yvonne from the chaos.
###Chapter 429 Shadows Rising

Time was running out.
###Chapter 430 Moon Goddess’s Blessing

###Chapter 431 A New Beginning

The moon hung full and bright in the night sky, casting silver light across the landscape as if the Moon Goddess herself was watching over them. In many ways, she was.

The supernatural world had finally found peace after the Moonveil Ascendancy fell apart completely.

The cult’s inner circle received life sentences in specialized supernatural prisons. 
Mid-level members faced decades behind bars, while those who’d been coerced or manipulated got lighter sentences with mandatory therapy and community service. 
Most importantly, their twisted "might makes right" philosophy had been publicly debunked by leading supernatural scholars. 
For the first time ever, humans and werewolves worked together as equals during the trials.

"Present the child," she commanded. 
Cecilia placed Aria in the elder’s arms without hesitation. Elder Luna Black lifted the baby toward the full moon. 
"We present Aria of Silver Peak, Protector of Peace. Blood of our Alpha, born of his blessed mate." 
Moonlight intensified around the baby. 
Aria opened her eyes and looked directly at the moon. 
Everyone gasped as they felt the Moon Goddess’s warm approval. 
"She accepts them both," Elder Luna Black whispered in wonder. 
The mate binding ceremony was beautiful. 
Alpha Sebastian’s voice rang out strong as he claimed Cecilia as his mate "before moon and stars, until death and beyond." 
Instead of traditional scars, Cecilia received a stunning silver tattoo between her shoulder blades, mixed with Alpha Sebastian’s blood. 
When he kissed her, the entire pack erupted in celebration. 
Human cheers mixed with wolf howls. 
The party lasted until dawn. Humans and wolves danced together under the stars. Old barriers forgotten, new friendships formed. 
As sunrise approached, Alpha Sebastian led her to their favorite cliff overlooking the valley. 
"I vow to protect what we’ve built here," Alpha Sebastian declared, his voice carrying on the wind. "This new path forward for all of us." 
The crowd cheered their approval. 
Cecilia felt completely, perfectly happy. "I love you," she whispered. 
"And I love you, my remarkable mate," Alpha Sebastian replied, pulling her close. 
Above them, the moon gave way to sunrise. 
In the valley below, their pack stood together in the growing light. 
Baby Aria chose that perfect moment to open her eyes and smile her very first smile. 
Their new beginning was just starting.
